spec_match.rationale: A realistic off-main-thread pipeline: CSSStyleValue.parse for validation, CSSUnitValue.to() for conversion, plus the structuredClone probe proving Typed OM objects do not cross postMessage — a genuinely spec-grounded serialization lesson.

interactive.rationale: Editable token sheet, scale and root-size sliders, and a run button that spawns a real worker; verified 6 of 8 default tokens survived, the table filled and six ramp bars rendered.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The card promises normalise-convert-scale-postMessage with the serialization caveat, which is exactly the page.

edge_cases.rationale: Invalid tokens (keyword 'medium', unitless 12) are rejected with reasons, worker failure and timeout are handled, and the no-Typed-OM fallback explains that its rem conversion is a guess.

conformance.rationale: The suite's in-worker parse/conversion assertions cover this pipeline; on Chromium 141 the route honestly reported 2 pass / 5 fail since worker exposure needs Chrome 154.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp): clicked run — worker processed 8 tokens (6 accepted with correct px math at scale 1.5, 2 rejected), preview bars rendered, fallback copy honestly attributed the parsing to the regex on this pre-154 build; console clean, screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Loads demo-telemetry.js and emits a tokens-processed assert with accepted/total/hasTyped/scale.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables, accepted/rejected verdicts as text plus colour, preview bars use accent variables, no static card.

accessibility.rationale: Controls are labelled with live value spans and the readout is aria-live, but the scaled-ramp preview bars convey their values only via title attributes and height — the per-bar values have no text equivalent outside the table.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: At 360x740 DPR3 the document scrollWidth is 362px and the mobile screenshot shows the stage border and the table's status column clipped at the right edge — a small but real overflow.

openQuestions.title: Remove the 2px 360px overflow and let the results table wrap
openQuestions.detail: At a 360px viewport the page measures 362px wide and the mobile screenshot shows the stage panel border and the five-column table's right edge clipped. The th/td rules here lack the overflow-wrap:anywhere the sibling parse-in-a-worker page uses, and the full-width textarea plus padding is the likely 2px culprit. Add overflow-wrap to the table cells and check the textarea's box sizing, then re-verify with deno task responsive-check.

openQuestions.title: Give the ramp preview bars a non-visual equivalent
openQuestions.detail: Each preview bar exposes its token name and scaled px only through a title attribute and its height. Add visible or visually-hidden text per bar (or an aria-label plus a figure caption tying the ramp to the table) so the scaled ramp is perceivable without hover or sight of relative heights.

summary: Reviewed at http://localhost:3000/v154/expose-cssstylevalue-hierarchy-to-worker-contexts/token-pipeline/ with Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp), where workers lack Typed OM; the pipeline honestly fell back to its regex path, said so, and still produced correct px normalisation and scaling (6/8 accepted, bars rendered). Console/network clean bar the sandbox font-CDN artifact; /conformance/ honestly reported 2 pass / 5 fail on this pre-154 build. Two small follow-ups: a 2px horizontal overflow at 360px with visible edge clipping, and title-only values on the preview bars.
